title: Privacy Policy
collect_body: If you sign in with a social account, we store your name, email, and avatar for comment identity. Comments you publish are stored on the server. Likes are de-duplicated by IP and are not required to be tied to an account. Reading history and on-device like state stay on your device only.
not_body: There is no third-party analytics SDK, no advertising tracking, and no App Tracking Transparency prompt. We do not sell your data.
delete_body: You can delete a reader account from the Me tab in the app. After deletion, the server-side login identity and comments associated with it are removed. Likes and reading history on the device are not cleared automatically.
contact_body: Questions about this policy can be sent via the email in the footer of innei.in.
terms_acceptance_body: By signing in to or using Yohaku, you agree to these terms. You must not post unlawful, threatening, harassing, hateful, sexually explicit, deceptive, spammy, or otherwise objectionable content.
terms_safety_body: Yohaku has zero tolerance for objectionable content and abusive users. Comments pass through content filters. Every comment can be reported, and signed-in readers can block its author; blocking immediately removes that reader’s comments from their view and sends the report to the developer. Reports are reviewed within 24 hours. Violating content is removed and abusive users are suspended or ejected from the service.

support_report_body: Please include your device model, iOS version, Yohaku version, and a short description of what happened. Do not send passwords or payment details.
support_response_body: Reports about objectionable content or abusive users are reviewed within 24 hours. Other support requests are answered as soon as possible.
